title: The Fallow Communion
logline: An agrarian monastic order's new abbot repeals an ancient seven-year soil sabbatical to boost famine shipments, sparking open revolt from traditionalist cellarers who believe forced cultivation will poison the sacred spores.

roles.description: Newly appointed head of the monastic agro-cathedral; pragmatic, burdened by external famine reports, determined to end the fallow period.
Elder cultivator of the subterranean fungal crypts; devout, stubborn, clutching centuries of mycorrhizal planting records.
The ascetic monastic community producing sacred protein yeast cakes for regional distribution.
Deep cold-storage cultivation vaults beneath the monastery where parent spore cultures hibernate.
An orbital freight dock where humanitarian food shipments are inspected and weighed.

public_situation: Freight haulers dock at {role:distribution_quarantine} to receive emergency protein relief as {role:monastic_agronomy} erupts into open schism over lifting a seven-year farming sabbatical.
private_truth: The new abbot signed advance famine relief contracts requiring forced nutrient cultivation that will permanently exhaust the monastery's irreplaceable parent mycelium strain.

beats.public_change: Notice boards across the monastery ring announce the immediate resumption of protein cake baking, overriding customary fallow banners.

missions.reason: He hires an independent pilot to scan humidity sensors across the fungal crypts and verify that forced nutrient feed won't trigger blight.
missions.private_fact: He promised the sector famine relief council twenty thousand metric tons of protein cakes before consulting the cellarers.

beats.public_change: Traditionalist cellarers barricade the lower airlocks with liturgical staves, threatening to vent heating pipes into space.

missions.reason: Deliver pulverized silicate grit to seal the ventilation risers leading to the upper hot-houses, blocking the abbot's forced-heating pipes.
missions.private_fact: She knows the parent culture survived three stellar flares only because previous generations respected the seven-year freeze.

beats.public_change: Humanitarian cargo freighters arrive at {role:distribution_quarantine} with empty holds, issuing an ultimatum for immediate food transfer.

missions.reason: Retrieve imported growth catalyst canisters from the orbital customs dock to inoculate the dormant beds by force.
missions.private_fact: The relief council offered to forgive forty thousand credits of monastery debt if the harvest ships on schedule.

player_choice.prompt: The catalyst canisters are on the dock. The cellarers bar the crypt doors with liturgical staves. The pilot holds the dispersal override.

options.label: Inject the synthetic catalyst to break the fallow sabbatical, maximizing immediate famine relief food at the risk of the heirloom strain
Hand the canisters to the cellar warden to lock the crypts in sabbatical rest, preserving the heirloom culture while relief ships go empty
Inoculate only half the secondary beds while sequestering the parent mycelium in cold dormancy

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot injects the catalyst and breaks the holy sabbatical.
resolutions.summary: The forced harvest ships on schedule, averting famine across two stations. The ancient fungal parent culture collapses, ending centuries of monastic lineage.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot forced open an abbey's fungal crypts, saving starving dockers at the cost of a holy crop.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the catalyst to the traditionalist cellarers.
resolutions.summary: The sabbatical is upheld and the spore beds sleep. The heirloom strain is preserved, but regional food riots erupt when empty relief barges return.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a split cultivation compromise.
resolutions.summary: Half-measures yield a modest harvest while the core spores sleep. Starvation is blunted and the holy strain survives, though neither faction is satisfied.

resolutions.reached_by: Heating conduits overheat the crypts without controls or intervention.
resolutions.summary: Heating pipes rupture into the unsealed crypts without controls. Thermal shock corrupts the fungal bed, destroying both the harvest and the holy lineage.

loose_threads.detail: Advance delivery bonuses for monastic protein wafers were posted on commodity bourses six weeks before the sabbatical vote.
The catalyst canister shipment was billed under commercial agrochemical codes rather than certified religious seals.
A keycard authorization log for the inner crypt vault shows three midnight entries stamped with an unassigned novice ID.

radio_hooks: Monastic agro-cathedral debates suspension of sacred seven-year soil sabbatical.
Outer colonies report deepening protein shortages awaiting abbey shipment allocations.
Disputes over sacramental yeast cultures disrupt orbital freight terminal schedules.

voice_direction.reformer_abbot: Smooth, measured, and weary. Speaks in theological justifications but his voice tightens whenever famine mortality curves are mentioned.
voice_direction.cellar_warden: Raspy, severe, and stubborn. Quotes foundational garden scriptures and treats commercial yields as vanity that invites blight.
